title: Credibility Clustering for Experience Rating: An Automated Approach to Risk Group Allocation in Group Life Insurance
abstract: arXiv:2611.07110v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In insurance, experience rating plays a crucial role in mitigating adverse selection by adjusting premiums according to historical claims experience. A key step in this process is the classification of insured collectives into homogeneous risk groups. Within group life insurance, this classification traditionally relies on manual decisions and arbitrary thresholds, which may lead to inefficiencies and inconsistent outcomes. This paper proposes a data-driven methodology for automating risk group allocation based on a combination of the multidimensional B\"uhlmann-Straub model and k-means clustering -- referred to as credibility clustering. By incorporating credibility weights, the method accounts for the varying statistical significance of experience data and ensuresthat risk classifications are both actuarially sound and practically implementable. translated_title: 面向经验费率的信度聚类：团体人寿保险中风险组分配的自动化方法
translated_abstract: 在保险业中，经验费率通过根据历史理赔经验调整保费，在缓解逆向选择方面发挥着至关重要的作用。这一过程中的关键步骤是将被保险团体划分到同质的风险组中。在团体人寿保险领域，这种划分传统上依赖于人工决策和任意设定的阈值，可能导致效率低下和结果不一致。本文提出了一种数据驱动的方法，结合多维 Bühlmann-Straub 模型与 k-means 聚类来自动化风险组分配——该方法被称为信度聚类。通过引入信度权重，该方法考虑了经验数据统计显著性的差异，确保风险分类既在精算上合理，又具备实际可操作性。基于某欧洲大型保险公司的真实团体人寿保险数据的实证结果表明……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将多维 Bühlmann-Straub 信度模型与 k-means 聚类相结合的“信度聚类”方法，以数据驱动方式自动完成团体人寿保险中的同质风险组划分，取代传统依赖人工决策与主观阈值的分类方式。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "credibility clustering," a data-driven approach combining the multidimensional Bühlmann-Straub model with k-means clustering to automatically allocate homogeneous risk groups in group life insurance, replacing traditional manual and threshold-based classification.
